name: DiagTrack
description: Sends usage and diagnostic data to Microsoft in the background.
impact: Nothing breaks. Windows just stops phoning home your usage stats.

name: dmwappushservice
description: Handles push-style messages used by mobile device management.
impact: Nothing breaks on a normal home PC. Only matters if a workplace manages this PC.

name: MapsBroker
description: Downloads and updates offline maps for the Maps app.
impact: The Maps app can't use offline maps. Online maps still work fine.

name: RetailDemo
description: Puts the PC into store demo mode for display units in shops.
impact: Nothing breaks. This is only useful on a shop display PC.

name: Fax
description: Lets the PC send and receive faxes through an old fax modem.
impact: You lose the ability to fax from the PC. Nobody will notice.

name: WMPNetworkSvc
description: Shares your media library with TVs and other devices on your network.
impact: Other devices can't browse media shared from this PC. Playing media locally is unaffected.

name: wisvc
description: Handles Windows Insider preview builds and flights.
impact: You can't join or receive Insider preview builds. Normal Windows updates still work.

name: Spooler
description: Every print job goes through this — it's what makes printing work.
impact: Printing stops working entirely. Keep this enabled if you own a printer.

name: RemoteRegistry
description: Lets other computers on the network read and change this PC's registry.
impact: Nothing breaks for normal use. Turning this off is actually safer.

name: WerSvc
description: Sends crash reports to Microsoft when apps crash.
impact: Nothing breaks. Crash reports just stop being sent.

name: seclogon
description: Lets you run a program as a different Windows user.
impact: 'Run as different user' stops working. Almost nobody uses it.

name: CertPropSvc
description: Handles certificates stored on smart cards, like corporate ID badges.
impact: Smart card logins stop working. Irrelevant without a smart card reader.

name: SCardSvr
description: Talks to smart card readers plugged into the PC.
impact: Smart card readers stop working. Irrelevant for most home PCs.

name: ScDeviceEnum
description: Notices when a smart card reader gets plugged in.
impact: Newly plugged-in smart card readers won't be picked up automatically.

name: SCPolicySvc
description: Locks the PC automatically when a smart card is pulled out.
impact: Auto-lock on smart card removal stops. Only matters if you use smart cards.

name: TrkWks
description: Keeps shortcuts working when a file gets moved to another drive.
impact: Shortcuts to moved files might break instead of fixing themselves. Minor.

name: CscService
description: Caches network files so you can keep working with them offline.
impact: Offline access to network folders stops. Only matters on work networks.

name: MSiSCSI
description: Connects to enterprise network storage (iSCSI targets).
impact: iSCSI storage connections stop. Only matters in business setups.

name: NetTcpPortSharing
description: Lets special business apps share the same network port.
impact: Those specific apps can't share ports. Normal apps are unaffected.

name: vds
description: Answers questions that apps ask about your disks — not the disks themselves.
impact: Disk tools might show less info. Your drives keep working normally.

name: WebClient
description: Lets you open WebDAV network folders as if they were local drives.
impact: WebDAV network folders stop working. Rarely used at home.

name: Wecsvc
description: Forwards this PC's event logs to a central company server.
impact: Nothing breaks at home. Only matters on managed corporate networks.

name: wcncsvc
description: An old, retired way of setting up Wi-Fi connections.
impact: Nothing breaks. This technology is deprecated.

name: PNRPSvc
description: Helps peer-to-peer apps find each other without a central server.
impact: Old peer-to-peer features (like Windows collaboration tools) stop resolving names. Rarely used.

name: p2psvc
description: Groups peer-to-peer apps together so they can cooperate.
impact: Old peer-to-peer features stop working. Rarely used.

name: p2pimsvc
description: Manages identities for peer-to-peer apps.
impact: Old peer-to-peer features stop working. Rarely used.

name: shpamsvc
description: Manages accounts on shared or guest PCs, like school computers.
impact: Shared-PC account features stop. Irrelevant on a personal PC.

name: AxInstSV
description: Installs ActiveX controls — an ancient Internet Explorer technology.
impact: Nothing modern breaks. ActiveX has been dead for years.

name: AppMgmt
description: Installs software pushed out by corporate Group Policy.
impact: Company-pushed software installs stop. Irrelevant on a home PC.

name: SmsRouter
description: Routes text messages on PCs with a SIM card inside.
impact: Texting from the PC stops. Only matters on cellular-connected PCs.

name: PhoneSvc
description: Manages mobile broadband and phone-related features.
impact: Cellular data features stop. Wi-Fi and Ethernet are unaffected.

name: SEMgrSvc
description: Handles NFC tap-to-pay and secure elements on the PC.
impact: NFC payments from the PC stop. Most desktops don't have NFC anyway.
